# polylane_team (Resource)

Manages a team within an existing Polylane workspace.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable team name.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace containing the team.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Color used for team badges in Polylane.
- `description` (String) Team description.
- `icon` (String) Polylane icon identifier for the team.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly team identifier. Polylane generates it from name when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the team was created.
- `created_by` (String) ID of the user who created the team.
- `id` (String) Unique Polylane team ID.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the team was last updated.
